# State Management Checklist: SPEC-009C4 - Owner Merge Gate and Done Reconciliation

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for `ready_for_owner` stability, exact merged-PR gating, manual sync reconciliation, duplicate-sync idempotency, and no duplicate successor launch.
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are state transition requirements complete for `ready_for_owner` before `G_PILOT_MERGE`, `ready_for_owner` after insufficient evidence, `done` after exact merged PR evidence, and `done` stability after duplicate sync? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, Spec FR-005, Spec FR-006, Spec FR-009, Data Model PR-Producing Pilot Task]
- [ ] CHK002 Are completion-gate requirements complete enough to require both the workflow-level `G_PILOT_MERGE` action and current verified GitHub merged truth for the exact linked PR? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Spec FR-002, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Contract Completion Rule]
- [ ] CHK003 Are manual sync requirements complete for using the existing `POST /api/github/sync` and `pullFromGitHub(project, workspaceId)` path as the only production reconciliation trigger in C4? [Completeness, Spec FR-003, Spec Clarifications Session 1, Contract Entrypoints]
- [ ] CHK004 Are task-chain advancement requirements complete for allowing `advanceTaskChain` only after verified `github_pr_merged` terminal evidence and preventing duplicate successor launch on repeat sync? [Completeness, Spec FR-009, Spec SC-004, Plan Summary, Contract Successful Side Effects]
- [ ] CHK005 Are local-only completion requirements complete enough to state that direct or local task status changes cannot satisfy the C4 terminal gate without post-merge manual sync evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-008, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is `G_PILOT_MERGE` clearly defined as a workflow-level manual checkpoint rather than a persisted runtime product state, automated validator action, packet field, or scheduler event? [Clarity, Spec FR-001, Spec Clarifications Session 1, Data Model Owner Merge Gate]

- [ ] CHK010 Is duplicate-sync idempotency clear about which repeated observations are allowed and which side effects must not repeat? [Clarity, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-010, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Contract Idempotency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can pre-merge state stability be objectively measured as 100% of covered cases remaining `ready_for_owner` before `G_PILOT_MERGE`? [Measurability, Spec SC-001, Spec User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK017 Can successful reconciliation be objectively measured as exactly one transition to `done` after owner merge plus one manual sync with exact merged PR evidence? [Measurability, Spec SC-002, Spec User Story 2, Contract Successful Side Effects]
- [ ] CHK018 Can negative reconciliation be objectively measured as 100% of closed-only and mismatched-PR cases remaining `ready_for_owner` with reconciliation-required evidence? [Measurability, Spec SC-003, Spec User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK019 Can duplicate sync safety be objectively measured as one terminal outcome and zero duplicate downstream launches after at least two repeated syncs? [Measurability, Spec SC-004, Spec User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK020 Can no local-only completion be objectively verified from a required post-merge manual sync evidence tuple that includes task id, workspace/project identity, exact PR identity, merged truth, sync row, status, terminal activity, done label projection, and duplicate-launch absence? [Measurability, Spec FR-008, Spec Clarifications Session 3]
